event.name: Hops Drops The Evergreen Music & Beer Festival

profile.description: Adventure Zone has emailed Hops Drops multiple times historically. Current official Hops Drops material still primarily displays the 2025 festival; a separate 2026 community performance page references Hops Drops on Oct. 17, 2026. The event is primarily a live-music and craft-beverage fundraiser with some free children's games/crafts, not a natural full inflatable-carnival fit.

notes.subject: 2026 review — weak fit / current details incomplete
notes.body: Gmail shows Adventure Zone outreach to Hops Drops in 2022, 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. The current official Hops Drops website still primarily presents the 2025 festival, while a 2026 community talent-program page references Hops Drops on Oct. 17. The festival's core is live music and craft beverages benefiting a community stage project; kids under 21 have historically been free with smaller games, trick-or-treating and crafts. Do not create routine full inflatable-carnival outreach unless the 2026 organizers specifically seek a substantially larger children's attraction component.
